description: Use for 'what date is N days, weeks, months or years before or after X', including business-day deadlines. Without exclusions, applies days, weeks, months, then years. With exclusions, all units become calendar days, and that many non-excluded days are counted: 1 month after 2027-01-15, excluding Saturday and Sunday, gives 2027-03-01, not 2027-02-15. The start date is not counted; the destination is. To move a plain date such as 'one month later' to a working day instead, set roll to next or previous. If holiday data is unavailable, the call fails. Returns the date, its weekday and ISO week, warnings to read, the rules used and a share link.

country.description: Canonical uppercase ISO country code; discover supported codes with list_locations.

excludeHolidays.description: Exclude public holidays, including observed dates, as full days. The data does not mark half-day holidays. Requires country; unavailable holiday data is an error.

excludeWeekdays.description: Weekdays to exclude: 0 Sunday through 6 Saturday. Default none. Use [0,6] for a Saturday and Sunday weekend; some countries have a different weekend, so choose the days for the country.

language.description: Website language, default en. All 32 site languages; nb/no and zh-Hans/zh-cn, zh-Hant/zh-tw aliases are accepted. Holiday names may fall back to their native language. Weekday names in results are always English.

region.description: Exact subdivision code from list_locations; omit for the national calendar.

roll.description: Default none. next or previous: apply the units as plain calendar arithmetic, then move day by day in that direction to the first day that is not excluded. Requires an exclusion, and not all seven weekdays.
